ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the upper part of the figure is an amino acid backbone, with an R substituent on the left, and the central carbon is connected to a carboxylic acid group C(=O)OH, and is connected through HN to the tetrahedral acyl intermediate below. The carbon at the lower reaction center is simultaneously connected to nitrogen, an oxygen bearing hydrogen, and an acetate oxy group, with curved arrows beside it showing the oxide/ lone pair electrons pushing back to form a carbonyl, while the electrons of the C-O bond connected to the acetate oxygen transfer onto the leaving acetate oxygen. Reasoning: After pushing according to the arrows, the tetrahedral intermediate collapses into an N-acetylated amide, that is, nitrogen is connected to C(=O)CH3; the leaving group becomes an acetate anion. The upper amino acid carboxylic acid remains unchanged, and R is represented by [*]. Therefore the product SMILES is [*]C(C(O)=O)NC(C)=O.CC([O-])=O.

method.method_draft: Inspect the image first and identify the reactive center below the amino acid nitrogen: the N is bonded to a tetrahedral acetyl carbon that also bears OH/oxo-forming oxygen and an acetate-derived O group. Follow the curved arrows: collapse the tetrahedral intermediate to an amide carbonyl attached to N and CH3, while the C-OAc bond electrons move onto the departing acetate oxygen. Keep the upper amino acid carboxylic acid unchanged and replace R with [*]. The resulting disconnected products are the N-acetyl amino acid fragment and acetate anion, giving [*]C(C(O)=O)NC(C)=O.CC([O-])=O.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中上方是一个氨基酸骨架，左侧为 R 取代基，中心碳连有羧酸基 C(=O)OH，并通过 HN 与下方的四面体酰基中间体相连。下方反应中心的碳同时连着氮、一个带氢的氧以及一个乙酸酯氧基，旁边有弯箭头显示氧负/孤对电子回推形成羰基，同时连接到乙酸酯氧的 C-O 键电子转移到离去的乙酸酯氧上。推理：按箭头推动后，四面体中间体塌陷为 N-乙酰化的酰胺，即氮连接到 C(=O)CH3；离去基成为乙酸根阴离子。上方氨基酸羧酸保持不变，R 用 [*] 表示。因此产物 SMILES 为 [*]C(C(O)=O)NC(C)=O.CC([O-])=O。
